notes: accept_source_upload: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST accept only the authenticated browser-owner context with valid same-origin and CSRF evidence, then call store_original_source with request.handoff_id, request.handoff_secret, request.display_filename, request.declared_media_type and the still-bounded BinaryUpload stream; never treat a filename, media declaration, handoff identifier, or browser control as storage-path or authorization evidence.

accept_source_upload_handler: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST enforce same-origin and CSRF before consumption, derive one safe display filename from the multipart UploadFile filename, construct BrowserUploadRequest with that filename and file.content_type, call accept_source_upload with the gateway, that request and one WebGatewayUploadFileBinaryUpload adapter over the multipart UploadFile whose synchronous read_chunk(max_bytes) reads at most max_bytes from file.file and enforces = config.upload.max_file_bytes across the complete stream without pre-buffering or interpreting the document; MUST NOT call UploadFile.read, buffer the complete upload, or instantiate the BinaryUpload interface itself.

issue_upload_handoff: [BEHAVIOR] MUST under one authorization decision, verify the exact Card, logical source, and expected current revision before issuing a new 900-second single-use handoff; persist only the verifier and return the bearer value once without placing it in Card data or logs; constructs the one-time SourceUploadHandoff value at the protected source-custody boundary.

issue_upload_handoff: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST open one CabinetUnitOfWork through unit_of_work_factory.open, begin, perform every Card and revision read and the handoff insert inside that transaction, commit exactly once on success, and roll back on every refusal or unexpected exception.

store_original_source: [PROVENANCE] MUST lock the exact handoff with `lock_handoff`, read bytes only through upload.read_chunk, identify an accepted content format from bounded bytes, require declared_media_type to be absent or agree with that identified type, preserve display_filename only as display/provenance metadata, stream to private candidate storage while calculating size and content hash, atomically commit immutable custody and consume the handoff, and make equal replay idempotent while rejecting conflicting bytes; neither display_filename nor declared_media_type is storage-path or authorization evidence.

store_original_source: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST open one CabinetUnitOfWork through unit_of_work_factory.open and begin before calling lock_handoff, keep every custody read, insert and handoff update inside that transaction, commit exactly once after the bytes are published, and roll back on every refusal or unexpected exception.

retrieve_original_source: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST resolve only the authorized Card/source pair to its immutable verified content reference, reopen a private regular file beneath the configured store, recheck integrity, and return one SourceCustodySourceDownload over the verified bytes of that file, whose describe() returns the exact ContentReference of the verified custody content with content_id=request.source_id, with no filesystem path or credential; the module constructs SourceCustodySourceDownload; MUST NOT instantiate the SourceDownload interface itself.

retrieve_original_source: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST open one CabinetUnitOfWork through unit_of_work_factory.open, begin, call load_source_custody for request.card_id and request.source_id inside that transaction, and finally call `rollback`; this read path never commits.

serve_source_download: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST return the concrete SourceDownload implementation obtained from source custody through retrieve_original_source as a non-inline attachment source using an encoded safe display filename and verified media type, disable active-content interpretation, and never expose the internal storage reference in headers, body, logs, or errors; MUST NOT instantiate the SourceDownload interface itself.

derive_authentication_abuse_context: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] MUST return canonical compact sorted-key JSON. When credential is non-null, credential.channel equals channel, and credential.credential_id equals credential_id, the exact object is `{"channel":channel,"credential_id":credential_id,"kind":"known"}`; otherwise it is `{"channel":channel,"kind":"unknown"}`. It MUST NOT include secret material, accept caller context, or create a separate unknown bucket from an attacker-chosen credential identity.

derive_entity_scope_key: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] MUST return lowercase SHA-256 over the exact bytes `b"cabinet-scope-v1\\x00" + canonical_json`, where canonical_json is compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON. The unscoped object is exactly `{"scope":null}`; a scoped object is `{"scope":{"entity_id":...,"entity_kind":...,"revision":...}}` and includes every nested CardRevisionReference field with timezone-aware datetimes normalized to UTC. It MUST NOT use delimiter concatenation, omit revision constituents, or use `str`, `repr`, reflection, or object identity.

issue_security_audit_id: [PROVENANCE] MUST return a newly generated UUID4 string on every call. Every SecurityAuditRecord construction MUST call it once and MUST NOT reuse a credential, principal, node, grant, request, or timestamp identity as `evidence_id`.

require_authenticated_local_node: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST return principal.node only when principal.channel is exactly `local_node`, principal.principal.principal_kind is exactly `local_backend_node`, node is non-null active `local_backend`, and node.principal_id equals principal.principal.principal_id; otherwise it raises AuthorizationDeniedError. It performs no I/O, reflection, fallback, or mutation and never constructs or substitutes another node.

authenticate_request: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST return exactly authenticate_channel_request(service.unit_of_work_factory, service.credential_pepper, service.clock, channel, presented_credential). It opens no UoW, catches no delegated exception, and contains no credential, throttle, subject-resolution, audit, or fallback implementation.

authorize_capability: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST return exactly evaluate_capability_grant(service.unit_of_work_factory, service.clock, principal, capability, entity_scope). It opens no UoW, catches no delegated exception, and contains no grant lookup, scope-key, audit, or fallback implementation.

enroll_principal: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST return exactly bootstrap_or_enroll_principal(service.unit_of_work_factory, service.credential_pepper, service.clock, operator, command). It opens no UoW, catches no delegated exception, and never treats command data as authentication proof.

provision_capability_grant: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST return exactly persist_capability_grant(service.unit_of_work_factory, service.clock, grantor, command). It opens no UoW, catches no delegated exception, and contains no private grant store or fallback implementation.

rotate_credential: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST return exactly rotate_principal_credential(service.unit_of_work_factory, service.credential_pepper, service.clock, operator, command). It opens no UoW, catches no delegated exception, and never retains either bearer.

revoke_credential: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST return exactly revoke_principal_credential(service.unit_of_work_factory, service.clock, operator, command). It opens no UoW, catches no delegated exception, and never treats command data as authentication proof.

authenticate_channel_request: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one UoW through unit_of_work_factory.open and begin. It parses the self-identifying bearer, loads only the candidate credential identity when present, supplies that candidate to derive_authentication_abuse_context only when its channel exactly matches, hashes the derived context through derive_abuse_context_hash, and acquires the locked throttle state. Active throttle records fresh denied audit, commits, and raises AuthenticationThrottledError. Otherwise it verifies through verify_bearer_credential and resolves exactly one subject: subject_kind equal to = rules.principal_catalogue.credential_subject_kinds.principal loads an active CabinetPrincipal whose principal_kind is one of = rules.principal_catalogue.human_kinds and produces AuthenticatedPrincipal with node None; subject_kind equal to = rules.principal_catalogue.credential_subject_kinds.node loads an active CabinetNodeIdentity with node_kind `local_backend`, checks its contract_version equals = rules.principal_catalogue.node_contract_version, loads by node.principal_id the exact active CabinetPrincipal whose principal_kind equals = rules.principal_catalogue.node_kind, and produces AuthenticatedPrincipal with that node. Every malformed, unknown, mismatched-kind/channel, inactive, revoked, unbound, cross-installation, or incompatible case takes one indistinguishable failure path: register_authentication_failure, fresh denied audit, commit, AuthenticationRequiredError. Success updates last_authenticated_at, registers success, appends fresh allowed audit, commits, and returns AuthenticatedPrincipal; plaintext is never retained. Every unexpected exception rolls back before re-raise.

resolve_trusted_browser_owner: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST accept only exact TrustedEdge label `owner`, open one UoW through unit_of_work_factory.open, begin, call `list_principals_by_kind` with = rules.principal_catalogue.owner_kind, finally call `rollback` after the read, and return AuthenticatedPrincipal with node None only when exactly one active non-revoked principal of that kind exists; every missing, duplicate, inactive, revoked, other-label, or unexpected case rolls back and raises AuthenticationRequiredError. It never validates Basic Auth itself or accepts a public listener.

evaluate_capability_grant: [BEHAVIOR] MUST open one operation UoW through unit_of_work_factory.open, begin, re-read the exact principal, and for channel local_node additionally re-read principal.node and require that node is active, node.principal_id equals principal.principal_id, and node.contract_version equals = rules.principal_catalogue.node_contract_version; other channels require node None. It derives the scope key only through derive_entity_scope_key and loads the exact principal/channel/capability/scope grant. It re-evaluates lifecycle and = rules.capability_catalogue.grantable, appends audit with fresh issue_security_audit_id, commits and returns only the matching scoped decision; every denial or unexpected exception rolls back before re-raise.

persist_capability_grant: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one UoW through unit_of_work_factory.open, begin, re-read the separately supplied AuthenticatedPrincipal grantor, require its principal active with principal_kind in = rules.principal_catalogue.human_kinds, require an active target, validate the exact pair against = rules.capability_catalogue.grantable, derive the scope key only through derive_entity_scope_key, and load the exact existing grant before conditionally inserting one CapabilityGrantRecord plus fresh SecurityAuditRecord. Exact replay commits no duplicate and returns created false; every refusal or unexpected exception rolls back without changing grant state.

bootstrap_or_enroll_principal: [PROVENANCE] MUST open and begin one UoW through unit_of_work_factory.open. Null operator is accepted only when no CabinetPrincipal with principal_kind in = rules.principal_catalogue.human_kinds exists and command.principal_kind equals = rules.principal_catalogue.owner_kind; otherwise it re-reads the separately supplied AuthenticatedPrincipal operator and requires its principal active with principal_kind in = rules.principal_catalogue.human_kinds. It inserts one CabinetPrincipal, mints its channel-bound credential on the same UoW with subject_kind = rules.principal_catalogue.credential_subject_kinds.principal and subject_id equal to the new principal_id, appends fresh SecurityAuditRecord, commits, and returns the bearer once; every refusal or unexpected exception rolls back, exposes no bearer, and persists no partial row.

rotate_principal_credential: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one UoW through unit_of_work_factory.open, begin, re-read the separately supplied AuthenticatedPrincipal operator and require its principal active with principal_kind in = rules.principal_catalogue.human_kinds, lock and load the named credential, verify exact principal/channel binding, retire it and mint the replacement on the same UoW with rotated_from_credential_id and the retired record's exact subject_kind, subject_id and channel, append fresh SecurityAuditRecord, and commit atomically. It preserves subject identity/channel, returns the new bearer once, never recovers the old bearer, and rolls back every refusal or unexpected exception.

revoke_principal_credential: [BEHAVIOR] MUST open one UoW through unit_of_work_factory.open, begin, re-read the separately supplied AuthenticatedPrincipal operator and require its principal active with principal_kind in = rules.principal_catalogue.human_kinds, lock and load only the named credential, verify exact principal binding, retire only that record, append fresh SecurityAuditRecord, and commit. Exact repeated revocation is idempotent; every mismatch, unauthorized request, or unexpected exception rolls back.

credential_vault: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST keep every plaintext secret transient: no function persists, logs, or retains a presented or minted bearer beyond its return value. No function begins, commits, or rolls back a transaction: the caller owns the supplied CabinetUnitOfWork. Across the module, every persisted or compared wall-clock timestamp MUST be a timezone-aware UTC value and MUST NOT be a naive datetime. Reflective attribute access over models, dependencies, or self (getattr, hasattr, setattr, delattr, vars) is forbidden across the module; every declared field and operation is addressed directly by name.

parse_bearer_credential: [BEHAVIOR] MUST split the presented value on the first `.` into `<credential_id>.<secret_material>` and return the pair only when both parts are non-empty; every other shape returns None without raising.
